card.name: Leftover product to be discarded
card.fires_on: Words like any, remaining, unused or in right after an instruction to discard or spit out leftover material, before the thing left behind (solution, medication, mucus). Also weakly on 'preparing' before 'and eating food' in sleep-behavior lists.

modes.label: Discard leftovers
modes.description: Words such as any, remaining or in that point to what is left in a vial, pen or suspension that should be thrown away.
modes.example: Discard unused product remaining<< in>> the prefilled pen or vial.
